name: record-trivia
description: Record & music trivia above the prompt while Claude works, built from your Discogs collection

discogsUsername.title: Discogs username
discogsUsername.description: Whose collection to build trivia from. Leave empty to use the built-in deck only.

discogsToken.title: Discogs personal access token
discogsToken.description: Needed if your collection is private (Discogs > Settings > Developers > Generate new token).

rotateSeconds.title: Seconds per card
rotateSeconds.description: How long each trivia card shows before the next one (the answer is revealed halfway).
